title: Expressive range / Dialed down

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Reduce visual intensity when people need to read information or recognize a partner’s contribution.
strategic_value: A restrained mode can make Instagram useful in information-heavy and partnership communications.
demonstration: Four examples combine white grounds, sparse gradient accents, photographs, illustration and text-led messages.
practical_value: Choose the quieter end of the system when information density needs more room.

content_islands.name: Information example
content_islands.spec: Place the larger statistics-and-phones composition above the smaller examples.

content_islands.name: Restrained examples
content_islands.spec: Compare the white illustration card, photo card and typographic tips card below.

reference_purposes.Intent: The case-study text says dialing down helps information-heavy assets communicate and avoids outshining partners.
reference_purposes.Expression: The examples use broad white fields and limited color.
reference_purposes.Application: The range demonstrates a lower-intensity mode for informational or partnership contexts.

ingredient.name: Dialed-down color
ingredient.role: Leave attention available for information and partners.
ingredient.application: Use fewer colors, emphasizing the gradient and white as the source describes.
ingredient.scope: The dialed-down end of this expressive range; no numerical color-area ratio is specified.
